capabilities: Fetch diary entries from a public Letterboxd RSS feed
Merge new diary entries into a Letterboxd Diary.md file
Create date-specific backlinks for watched movies
Run a Sync Letterboxd Diary command from the command palette
extras: Only pulls the last 50 diary entries at a time due to RSS limits; after setup it merges entries going forward. The author asks for user feedback and help.
problem: Letterboxd's API is restrictive, and Obsidian has no built-in way to pull your watched-movie history into your vault.

relations.evidence: This project syncs your Letterboxd diary to a file in Obsidian

summary: Syncs your public Letterboxd diary via RSS into an Obsidian note with date-specific backlinks for tracked movie watching.
